note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; nothing is assessed.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional interview: the client gives the account first, the interviewer asks and marks two questions, and the client's answer adds the clarified detail (as supplied).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the interviewer opens with the first question (sequence interviewer→client), three questions are asked before the clarification, different people and content; the hold shows the clarified detail.

props.account: I lent my bike to a friend and it came back with a bent wheel.
props.clarification: It was left at the station rack, not at home

annotations.text: Each mark means the question was asked

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names and roles, four long questions, a long account, a long clarified detail and two callouts.

props.listTitle: Questions prepared before the first meeting
questions: On which exact day did the damaged parcel arrive at your address?
On which day did you send the first email to the online seller?
Did anyone from the seller reply to that first email, and when?
Do you still have the original packaging and the delivery note?
props.account: The parcel with the ceramic lamp arrived with a broken base, and I wrote an email to the online seller sometime during that same week, before the weekend started.
props.clarification: The first email to the seller was sent on day 3, the Wednesday after delivery

annotations.text: The clarified detail is added below the account exactly as supplied by the client
A pen mark next to a question only records that it was asked
